approved_command_preview: Read-only Windows PowerShell probe of the nested command-array construction used by PR #423 reusable workflow. No repository or live-target mutation.
command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $commands = @(@('Shared source contract','python','one.py'),@('Behavior check','python','two.py','--check')); Write-Host ('outer_count=' + $commands.Count); for ($i=0; $i -lt $commands.Count; $i++) { Write-Host ('item_' + $i + '_type=' + $commands[$i].GetType().FullName); Write-Host ('item_' + $i + '_count=' + $commands[$i].Count) }; if ($commands.Count -ne 2) { throw 'Nested command arrays were flattened' }; if ($commands[0].Count -ne 3 -or $commands[1].Count -ne 4) { throw 'Nested command arrays did not retain expected elements' }; Write-Host 'nested_command_array_probe=pass'
